messages:
maya: Quick sync — want to align on SLO-driven visibility acceptance criteria for the observability surface we ship with Console. Focus: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and error analytics. Who's free to scope now?
kevin: I can do 20 mins now. Are we targeting SLOs per-service or per-route?
maya: Per-service for launch, per-route as a stretch. The ask from customer A was per-route slices for top 10 error types but we may surface that later.
olivia: From a UX/devex perspective the minimum ship is: 1) 3 dashboards (health, latency, cost), 2) trace hooks for top 5 slow endpoints, 3) cost-by-model/token breakdown, 4) error-slice drilldown with time filters. Anything below that will create too many follow-ups.
saad: Oncall needs actionable signals. If one of the service SLOs crosses 95% of error budget, we should have an automatic alert and a quick link to the trace sample + recent deploys. Also need runbook link in the dashboard footer.
kevin: Agree. For acceptance tests I propose a concise checklist we can run in staging. Rough draft:
```
- ingest traffic that produces a 5% error spike on service X -> dashboard shows error % increase within 2m
- trigger synthetic latency on endpoint Y -> tracing shows spans for that endpoint and top 3 stack frames
- generate 10k tokens across models -> cost breakdown shows per-model tokens and per-token cost delta
- query error-slice UI -> returns grouped errors and drilldown links
```
maya: Nice. Can we make the first two automated as part of the pre-release gating? If they fail, block GA.
kevin: We can automate the synthetic latency and error injection in the CI harness. Cost tests are non-blocking; they can be a smoke job.
olivia: UX question — do we expose raw spans or pre-filtered samples? Customers asked for raw sometimes but that leaks noise. Proposal: default to sampled+stack-aggregated view with a toggle for raw spans.
saad: Toggle + warning + RBAC is fine. For Private deployments we must ensure traces don't leak PII by default; add a redact step.
maya: Agreed on redaction. Also need to call out rollout policy: canary (10%) -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with automatic rollback if latency P95 > baseline + 30% or error rate > 1% absolute.
kevin: One last tradeoff: adding route-level SLOs inflates ingestion/retention costs. Suggest we ship with per-service SLOs and a self-serve opt-in for route-level slicing that flips on extra retention and quota warnings.
olivia: That aligns with customer expectations. We should add a clear pricing note in the Console (and a warning banner when they enable it).
maya: OK next steps: kevin -> finalize acceptance harness tickets; olivia -> UX microcopy + default settings; saad -> runbook drafts + alert thresholds; I'll sync with sales on customer-GA comms. Can we reconvene Fri 10am?
kevin: @maya works for me.
olivia: :thumbsup:
saad: On it.
console-bot: Created ticket PROD-4987 for "SLO-driven visibility acceptance checklist" and linked to this thread.
